card.name: Ending of trastuzumab conjugate drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of the drug names emtansine (the 'ine' after 'emtans') and deruxtecan (the 'can' after 'deruxte'), in trastuzumab-related text.

modes.label: emtansine ending
